title: Conscious and Unconscious Memory Systems
venue_or_status: Cold Spring Harbor Perspectives in Biology; published scholarly review
evidence_note: Synthesizes human amnesia and animal evidence for distinct memory systems.
limitation: A taxonomy and synthesis, rather than a single causal experiment.
population_or_model: Review of human and animal research
review_level: Selected full-text taxonomy and systems-comparison sections

title: Why There Are Complementary Learning Systems in the Hippocampus and Neocortex: Insights From the Successes and Failures of Connectionist Models of Learning and Memory
venue_or_status: Psychological Review; published theoretical and computational analysis
evidence_note: Connectionist analyses motivate rapid episodic learning and slower integration of shared structure.
limitation: The model does not establish uniformly slow cortical learning or universal remote-memory independence.
population_or_model: Connectionist models interpreted against human and animal evidence
review_level: Abstract and selected full-text theory, interference, interleaving, and fast-learning discussion

title: The hippocampal indexing theory and episodic memory: updating the index
evidence_note: Proposes hippocampal binding and reinstatement of distributed cortical episode representations.
limitation: A theoretical synthesis; indexing does not guarantee complete or accurate recall.
population_or_model: Theory synthesizing human and animal memory research
review_level: Primary abstract and publication metadata; full text not inspected

title: Requirement for Hippocampal CA3 NMDA Receptors in Associative Memory Recall
evidence_note: CA3 receptor deletion disproportionately impaired spatial recall under partial environmental cues.
limitation: Altered representation formation can later resemble a retrieval-specific deficit.
population_or_model: Genetically manipulated mice
review_level: Abstract and selected indexed primary experiment and discussion excerpts; complete full text not inspected

title: Engram Cells Retain Memory Under Retrograde Amnesia
evidence_note: Tagged-cell activation restored conditioned behavior after experimentally induced natural-cue amnesia.
limitation: Behavioral rescue does not establish preservation of every episodic feature.
population_or_model: Mice with tagged engram cells and protein-synthesis inhibition
review_level: Primary abstract and selected indexed primary figure captions and results excerpts

title: Schemas and memory consolidation
evidence_note: Prior flavor-place associative knowledge enabled rapid integration of new associations.
limitation: A trained rat task does not establish arbitrary human schema-based assimilation.
population_or_model: Rats learning flavor-place associations
review_level: Primary abstract and publication metadata; full text not inspected

title: Memory formation and long-term retention in humans and animals: convergence towards a transformation account of hippocampal-neocortical interactions
evidence_note: Argues that detailed and schematic representations can coexist during memory transformation.
limitation: A competing account of consolidation, rather than a universally settled mechanism.
population_or_model: Review of human and animal memory findings
review_level: Primary abstract and publication metadata; complete full text not inspected

title: Discovering Event Structure in Continuous Narrative Perception and Memory
evidence_note: Narrative fMRI links hierarchical event boundaries with hippocampal activity and recall reinstatement.
limitation: Model-derived boundaries and correlations do not establish a universal optimal segmentation.
population_or_model: Human participants viewing and recalling narratives
review_level: Selected full-text summary, event-model, hippocampal activity, and discussion sections

title: The Godden and Baddeley (1975) experiment on context-dependent memory on land and underwater: a replication
venue_or_status: Royal Society Open Science; published replication study
evidence_note: A diver word-list replication did not recover a same-environment recall advantage.
limitation: Setting and timing differences constrain generalization beyond the attempted replication.
population_or_model: Human divers learning and recalling word lists
review_level: Abstract and selected full-text methods, results, and discussion

title: Selective suppression of hippocampal ripples impairs spatial memory
evidence_note: Post-training ripple disruption impaired spatial learning relative to stimulation controls.
limitation: Associated neural discharge was suppressed; replay sequence content was not selectively manipulated.
population_or_model: Rats in a spatial learning task
review_level: Main brief communication, including protocol, controls, and discussion; supplements not inspected

title: Odor cues during slow-wave sleep prompt declarative memory consolidation
evidence_note: Learning-associated odor cueing benefited declarative retention under slow-wave-sleep conditions.
limitation: Effects depended on learning, memory task, cue, and physiological state.
population_or_model: Human participants in declarative and procedural learning conditions
review_level: Primary abstract and reported control conditions; complete full text not inspected

title: Remembering can cause forgetting: Retrieval dynamics in long-term memory
venue_or_status: Journal of Experimental Psychology: Learning, Memory, and Cognition; published research article
evidence_note: Practicing selected category members impaired later recall of related unpracticed members.
limitation: Impaired recall does not prove erasure or universal adaptive benefit.
population_or_model: Human category-exemplar retrieval experiments
review_level: Abstract and selected full-text experiment, output-order control, and interpretation sections

title: Multiple routes to memory: Distinct medial temporal lobe processes build item and source memories
venue_or_status: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences; published research article
evidence_note: Encoding activity in different medial temporal regions predicted item recognition versus source recollection.
limitation: Subsequent-memory fMRI correlations do not establish exclusive or causal regional functions.
population_or_model: Human fMRI participants learning items under distinct encoding conditions
review_level: Full-text abstract and selected introductory description of design and findings

title: Fear memories require protein synthesis in the amygdala for reconsolidation after retrieval
evidence_note: Post-reactivation protein-synthesis inhibition caused amnesia under timing and reactivation controls.
limitation: Drug-induced amnesia does not establish irreversible erasure or lability after every retrieval.
population_or_model: Rats in auditory fear-conditioning experiments
review_level: Primary abstract and reported reactivation/timing controls; full text not inspected

title: Reconsolidation of episodic memories: A subtle reminder triggers integration of new information
evidence_note: Reminding before new-list learning produced delayed intrusions into original-list recall.
limitation: Behavioral updating does not uniquely identify cellular reconsolidation over contextual explanations.
population_or_model: Human participants learning and recalling object lists
review_level: Abstract and selected indexed primary results and general-discussion excerpts

title: Creating False Memories: Remembering Words Not Presented in Lists
venue_or_status: Journal of Experimental Psychology: Learning, Memory, and Cognition; published research article
evidence_note: Associated word lists elicited confident recall and recognition of unpresented words.
limitation: A laboratory paradigm does not quantify everyday autobiographical error rates.
population_or_model: Human participants learning semantically associated word lists
review_level: Abstract and selected indexed primary introductory and experiment excerpts; complete full text not inspected

title: Selection of experience for memory by hippocampal sharp wave ripples
evidence_note: Waking ripple content predicted preferential replay of particular trial blocks during sleep.
limitation: Observational replay selection was not linked to trial-specific long-term behavioral retention.
population_or_model: Mice with hippocampal ensemble recordings
review_level: Selected main-text results, discussion, and figures; supplements not inspected

title: Systems consolidation reorganizes hippocampal engram circuitry
evidence_note: Neurogenesis and circuit interventions link hippocampal reorganization with contextual or spatial memory resolution.
limitation: Task generalization is not human semantic memory; replay was not selectively manipulated.
population_or_model: Mice with neurogenesis, newborn-neuron, engram, and projection manipulations
review_level: Primary abstract and extended-data captions 2, 4, 7, 9, and 10; gated main text not inspected

title: Replay without sharp wave ripples in a spatial memory task
venue_or_status: Nature Communications; published 21 November 2025; reference-list author correction 17 April 2026
evidence_note: Sequence detection independent of ripples identified replay without detectable sharp-wave ripples.
limitation: Detection and recording coverage bound absence claims; functional necessity was not established.
population_or_model: Male rats performing a spatial task
review_level: Selected full-text results, discussion, and detection methods; complete correction text inspected through indexed publisher and PMC primary pages, direct correction fetch blocked

title: Replay of procedural memory is independent of the hippocampus
venue_or_status: Nature Neuroscience; published research article, 23 July 2026
evidence_note: Striatal replay persisted after hippocampal lesions and was associated with later procedural improvement.
limitation: Receptor blockade affected broader plasticity; replay itself was not selectively disrupted.
population_or_model: Mice in a procedural learning task
review_level: Selected full-text results, methods, and discussion

title: Hippocampal ripples initiate cortical dimensionality expansion for memory retrieval
venue_or_status: Nature Communications; published research article, 20 July 2026
evidence_note: Human intracranial recordings linked successful retrieval, hippocampal ripples, and cortical dimensionality expansion.
limitation: Observations do not prove ripple causality or directly measure compressed hippocampal encoding.
population_or_model: Human epilepsy patients with clinically placed intracranial electrodes
review_level: Selected full-text results, discussion, ripple controls, and dimensionality methods in publisher PDF

title: Comprehensive protein synthesis inhibition impairs natural and artificial memory recall
venue_or_status: Molecular Brain; published Micro Report, 29 April 2026; version of record updated 16 June 2026
evidence_note: Combined protein-synthesis inhibitors impaired both natural and optogenetically elicited conditioned recall.
limitation: Broad drugs and different circuitry do not locate erasure versus access or expression failure.
population_or_model: Male ArcCreERT2 mice; ventral CA1 to basal-amygdala pathway
review_level: Main-text methods, results, limitations, and Figure 1; supplements not inspected
